captions.detailed: A compact, mirrorless-style prime camera lens with a matte black barrel and a blue-tinted glass front element. It features two distinct ribbed control rings: a wide focus ring near the middle and a narrower aperture ring near the rear mount. Both the focus ring and the aperture ring rotate continuously around the central optical axis of the lens barrel, each marked with a small rectangular indicator.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact prime camera lens. It should feature a main cylindrical barrel with a blue-tinted front glass element, a wide ribbed focus ring that rotates continuously, and a narrower ribbed aperture ring near the rear mount that also rotates continuously.
captions.factory: The lens is constructed by defining a series of coaxial cylinders for the main body, front glass element, and rear mount. The focus ring and aperture ring are created as separate cylindrical parts with ribbed textures generated through repeated boolean cuts or pattern operations. Two continuous joints (revolute with no limits) are established along the Z-axis to connect the focus ring and the aperture ring to the main lens barrel.
